title: Why Does a Roti Puff Up?
description: Why does a roti puff up like a balloon? The simple science of steam and layers.
comment: Does your roti always puff? Tell me below!

scenes.text: Why does a roti puff up like a balloon?
Roti dough has a lot of water inside it, and it is rolled into thin layers.
On the hot tawa and flame, that water turns into steam.
Steam takes much more space than water, so it pushes the two layers apart. And the roti puffs up.
If the roti is rolled evenly, the steam stays trapped. A small tear lets the steam escape, and it stays flat.
So rest the dough, roll evenly, and cook on a hot tawa.
